title: Group Fitness Class Passes: peak-hour surcharge, off-peak discount, holiday blackout and app-booking requirement by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the surcharge for booking a class in peak demand hours, the discount for booking a class in off-peak hours, whether booking is restricted on published holiday blackout dates, and whether bookings for the tier must be made through the mobile app.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes an extra fee for booking a class in peak demand hours (zero where no peak surcharge applies) and, independently, a discount rate for booking a class in off-peak hours (zero where no off-peak discount applies). Each tier fixes whether published holiday blackout dates restrict booking for that tier, and whether the tier's bookings must be made through the mobile app rather than any other channel.

| Tier | Peak surcharge (USD) | Off-peak discount | Holiday blackout applies | App booking required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 0 | 0% | Yes | No |
| 10-Class Pack | 0 | 0% | Yes | No |
| 20-Class Pack | 0 | 5% | Yes | No |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 5.00 | 0% | Yes | Yes |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 0 | 0% | Yes | No |
| Founding Class Pass | 0 | 5% | No | No |

## Points of judgement
- The Founding Class Pass is the only tier exempt from published holiday blackout dates; every other tier is restricted on those dates.
- Only the Unlimited Monthly Classes tier charges a peak-hour surcharge, and it is also the only tier whose bookings must be made through the mobile app.
- The 20-Class Pack and Founding Class Pass are the only tiers offering an off-peak discount (5% each); no tier combines a peak surcharge with an off-peak discount.
